## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for new or changed behaviour (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run mypy` pass
- [ ] Docstrings and docs updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Per-event results unchanged, or the change is described (the paper's numbers depend on them)
